MonitoringProgramDescription: Lake Tahoe's surface water has warmed over the last half century. Warmer water mixes less often, holds less oxygen at depth, and favors algae and warm-water invasive species.
MonitoringApproach: A buoy at mid-lake records the surface temperature through the year. The chart shows the daily mean in degrees Fahrenheit for the most recent year published.
